gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-sundane: Distinct, a bit regal, and generously spaced. Noto Sans Sundanese sits beneath Metamorphous with barely any gap between its lowercase and capitals, so the heading's soft strokes get the page's only flourish.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Noto Sans Sunuwar reads friendly, its curves leaving real daylight and its ascender stems kept short. Noto Sans Sunuwar stays quiet while Metamorphous brings a faint crayon-like thick-thin rhythm, and that gap is the whole charm.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-syloti-: Stately and slightly quirky, with generous space around every letter. Noto Sans Syloti Nagri keeps ascenders short and the lowercase tall, so a long passage settles into a sturdy, easy rhythm beneath Metamorphous.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-syriac-: Noto Sans Syriac Western reads modern and compact, its small letters dense with height. Noto Sans Syriac Western holds terminals far from the stroke body, which sets it clearly apart from the mildly contrasted Metamorphous above.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Commanding from the first line, with no harsh thin spots. Noto Sans Tamil is the one that keeps text looking enlarged and open at ordinary sizes, while Metamorphous does its best work with a lightly modulated stroke and plenty of presence.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-tamil-s: Metamorphous brings a mild, pen-like variation in weight and a high-set midline. And Noto Sans Tamil Supplement answers with round forms like open parentheses and a middle band so tall the line looks stocky.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Approachable first, then a little grand. Noto Sans Tangsa does the everyday work with wide, inviting round letters, while Metamorphous saves its tempered stroke contrast for the moments that want some swagger.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-tc: Metamorphous has a high-set midline and generous space around each letter. Noto Sans TC lets a long passage flow, with large open counters and curves that open outward rather than curling in.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Noto Sans Telugu keeps a high midline and counters that connect to the outside. Noto Sans Telugu stays modest, leaving Metamorphous to earn its keep big and short, with its gently varied lowercase a.
